The '''R1-series astromech droid''', also known as the '''R1 reactor drone''', was [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] first production model of their new consumer-market [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] line.

==Description==
The R1-series integrated the developments of the [[P2-series astromech droid|P2-series]] prototype [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] and was an improvement over the P2, despite its unconventional appearance. As a result of the legal cases that stopped [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] bringing the P2 to the commercial market, the R1 reused the black body shells from the company's [[Mark II reactor drone/Legends|Mark II reactor drones]]. The dense shielding of the heavy shell gave the R1 protection against intense [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] moved about via a [[treaded unipod]], which was slow and often malfunctioned, causing a frequent lack of locomotion.<ref name="EGTD" />

The center of the R1's design was the [[Intellex III]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Droid brain/Legends|brain]], which contained a comprehensive catalog of five hundred [[Starship/Legends|starship]] configurations<ref name="EGTD" /> and an operating speed of 10,000 MPF. The computer made the R1 capable of handling large [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="J7">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref> In addition, the R1 was the first Industrial Automaton astromech able to calculate complex navigational coordinates necessary to complete a single [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump.<ref name="EGTD" />

[[File:ActuallyAnR1.jpg|thumb|left|A [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]]-modified R1 [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].]]
R1s possessed a number of retractable tools that made them efficient [[Technician/Legends|technicians]]. The droids were also capable of producing "[[Binary/Legends|Droidspeak]]", allowing them to effectively coordinate with other droids and data networks. However, their personalities tended towards being obstinate<ref name="EGTD" /> and surly. Regular [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]] were used to counter this issue, but it had a side effect of ensuring that the droids were less than familiar with the ships they were stationed on.<ref name="AEG" /> Owners often complained about the droid's personalities and the frequent breakdown of the treader unipod. Industrial Automaton promised to address all these issues in their next model.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
While ongoing legal issues stalled the release of Industrial Automaton's [[P2-series astromech droid]], the company's creative, technical, and marketing departments did not sit idle waiting for the lawsuit to move through the judiciary. In an attempt to recover the millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] being lost, the company created the R1 with as little overhead costs as possible. The droid series was designed, marketed, and distributed in less that a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] and proved to be a roaring success.<ref name="J7" /> Due to its cumbersome size, R1s were commonly stationed aboard [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and large [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].<ref name="EGTD" />

[[File:Wattos_R1_unit.png|thumb|right|The R1 unit behind the counter in the shop Watto's Parts.]]
By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] owned an R1-series astromech droid, kept behind the counter in [[Gender/Legends|his]] shop [[Wald's Parts|Watto's Parts]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

An R1 was employed as the principal controller of the ''[[Sun Runner]]'' [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit ship]] fabricated in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-foiled attempt to destroy the orbital [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]. Coming face to face in the ship's control chamber with a 18-year-old [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the R1 droid triggered a self-annihilating shutdown just prior to Skywalker destroying the false ''Sun Runner'' itself with a [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]]-planted [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]].<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>

The R1-series was highly successful and well regarded. As a follow-up, [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] designed and released the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
